Package com.csse3200.game.components.inventory

Class InventoryComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.inventory.InventoryComponent
public class InventoryComponent extends Component
A component intended to be used by the player to track their inventory.

Tracks the player's gold, stored items, inventory capacity, and currently selected item.

      public InventoryComponent(int gold)

    • InventoryComponent

      public InventoryComponent(int gold, int capacity)
      Creates a single-row inventory with a configurable number of distinct item stacks.
      Parameters:
      gold - starting gold
      capacity - number of slots in the single row, from 1 to 9

    • InventoryComponent

      public InventoryComponent(int gold, int rows, int columns)
      Creates an inventory with configurable grid dimensions.

      The first row is the hotbar. Columns are limited to nine so every hotbar slot has a number key.

      Parameters:
      gold - starting gold
      rows - number of inventory rows
      columns - number of slots per row, from 1 to 9

      public boolean addItem(ItemType item, int quantity)
      Adds the requested quantity of an item to the inventory.

      If the quantity is invalid or there is no available slot for a new item type, the inventory remains unchanged.

      Parameters:
      item - item type to add
      quantity - quantity to add
      Returns:
      true if the item was successfully added

    • removeItem

      public boolean removeItem(ItemType item, int quantity)

      Parameters:

      quantity - quantity to remove
      Returns:
      true if the item was successfully removed

    • sortByItemId

      public boolean sortByItemId()
      Sorts occupied slots by stable numeric item ID and moves empty slots to the end.

      If an item is selected, that item remains selected at its new slot index. A selected empty slot remains at the same physical index.

      Returns:
      true when the slot order changed
